comments:
after #33703, set clientConn::ctx = nil at [clientConn::handleChangeUser](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/master/server/conn.go#L2344)
in package `expensivequery`, [`Handle::Run`](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/master/util/expensivequery/expensivequery.go#L63)  will call [`server::ShowProcessList`](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/master/server/server.go#L623-L646) every 100 Millisecond, maybe triggering trigger  panic

it will be also maybe panic when call `server::ShowProcessList` in other case

review_comments: Is it ok not to auth?
I think so, as you can see `openSessionAndDoAuth` in line 2349.

However, is it fine to only re-set the context here? like:

```
	cc.ctx, err = cc.server.driver.OpenCtx(cc.connectionID, cc.capability, cc.collation, cc.dbname, tlsStatePtr)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
```

https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/334508e13d556aef1f1f6f766aacc9c70b44626c/server/conn.go/#L798-L801
